jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description: You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply. A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since. As part of A·Team, you can expect: High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc. Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can. Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about. Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate. How to apply: Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit. What you’ll do: Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. We're looking for exceptional Software Engineers to join our model training team. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg . Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus. jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Social Media und Newsletter (m/w/d), remote
jobs.description: Ich bin Nadine Brandstätter, Steuerberaterin mit dem Schwerpunkt auf Kapitalgesellschaften. Meine Kanzlei ist komplett digital und ortsunabhängig. Ich begleite GmbH-Geschäftsführer:innen dabei, ihre Struktur steuerlich zu nutzen und Vermögen aufzubauen. Auf Instagram und LinkedIn poste ich regelmäßig zu Steuern und aktuellen Themen, und zwar so, dass Unternehmer:innen etwas damit anfangen können. Dazu kommt ein Newsletter für GmbH-Gesellschafter:innen. Für die Produktion gibt es bereits einen festen Ablauf, der sich alle 14 Tage wiederholt: von der Planung über die Umsetzung bis zur Auswertung. Dabei suche ich Unterstützung. Die Stelle ist bewusst offen formuliert. Stunden, Arbeitszeiten und Schwerpunkt stimmen wir gemeinsam ab. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst Recherchen und setzt Reels, Karussells und Posts für Instagram und LinkedIn um. Die Inhalte kommen von mir, du gestaltest sie in Canva, schneidest kurze Videos und planst alles in Metricool ein. Du bereitest den Newsletter vor, setzt ihn auf und kümmerst dich um den Versand. Du pflegst unseren Redaktionsplan in Notion und behältst Termine im Blick. Du wertest aus, welche Beiträge gut laufen, und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du arbeitest mit Tools wie Claude, Canva und Edits und hilfst mir, die Abläufe weiter zu optimieren. Was du mitbringst Du bist an einer Hochschule in Deutschland eingeschrieben, zum Beispiel in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien oder BWL. Du kennst Instagram und LinkedIn aus Nutzer:innensicht und hast ein Gespür dafür, was funktioniert. Du hast schon mit Canva gearbeitet und schneidest kurze Videos am Handy oder Rechner. Erfahrung mit Metricool, Notion oder einem Newsletter-Tool ist willkommen. Du schreibst sauber und hast keine Angst vor Steuerthemen. Fachwissen brauchst du nicht, die Inhalte liefere ich. Du arbeitest zuverlässig und selbstorganisiert und meldest dich, wenn etwas unklar ist. Was ich dir biete Du arbeitest komplett remote, von wo aus du willst, solange es innerhalb Deutschlands ist. Du arbeitest bis zu 20 Stunden pro Monat in der Vorlesungszeit, in den Semesterferien nach Absprache auch mehr. Deine Arbeitszeiten richtest du nach deinem Studium. Wir starten mit sechs Monaten, eine längere Zusammenarbeit ist ausdrücklich gewünscht. Du lernst, wie Content-Marketing für eine Expertenmarke von der Idee bis zur Auswertung läuft. Du arbeitest mit aktuellen KI-Tools und baust mit mir automatisierte Abläufe auf. Du hast kurze Wege zu mir und bekommst direktes Feedback. Vergütung: EUR 15 bis 18 pro Stunde, je nach Erfahrung So bewirbst du dich Nutzen Sie den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauche ich nicht. Schreib mir in ein paar Sätzen, was du studierst, wie viele Stunden du arbeiten möchtest und ab wann du starten kannst. Häng bitte deinen Lebenslauf und deine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung an. Wenn du schon Beiträge gestaltet hast, schick mir gerne zwei oder drei Beispiele oder einen Link. Ich melde mich umgehend bei dir. Danach lernen wir uns in einem Videocall kennen. Und wenn du noch mehr über mich und meine Kanzlei erfahren willst, dann schau unter nadinebrandstaetter.de. Transition the P&I organisation to structured and disciplined operational management. Ensure shared services, modular interfaces, and governed data access create the right foundations for future AI acceleration. Provide leadership for internal engineering enablement through the Developer Experience function. Define, build, and own Hawk-Eye’s internal Platform-as-a-Service. You are a strong technology leader with real experience building data-driven product capabilities in organisations where reliability, scale, and coordination matter. You join HawkEye with the know-how in creating the ownership, standards, operating discipline, and trust that make good engineering practices useful in practice. You are credible with senior engineers, comfortable in operationally demanding environments, and able to move between cloud infrastructure, data foundations, organisational design, and delivery reality without losing the plot. You know how to centralise what must become shared capability without hollowing out the autonomy and judgement of teams that build on top of it. You care about engineering quality, but you care just as much about business consequence. You know that reliability protects customer trust, governed data creates leverage, and shared standards only matter when they make the organisation materially better at delivering outcomes. jobs.title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It’s no simple task, but it wouldn’t be interesting if it was!</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Money is DoorDash’s organisation responsible for the financial products and infrastructure that enable transactions across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo. The domain owns how consumers pay, how merchants and couriers are paid, and how money is recorded, reconciled and reported, covering payment processing, payment methods, payouts, invoicing, financial ledgers and regulatory compliance.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Money Domain. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Invoicing Platform, Payment Instruments, amongst others; working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, scalable Money capabilities for the business. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, and regulatory / compliance products. They require strong technical judgment, cross organisational coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.</p> <p>You will report into the centralised global Technical Program Management team in Engineering, through a manager based in London. This is a hybrid role based in our London office in Cannon Street.</p> <h2>You're excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li>Drive Money Domain’s Most Strategic Programs - You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy &amp; Operations, and cross-functional teams to turn Money Domain’s strategy into executable technical programs.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lead Complex Cross-Organization Execution — Money Domain interacts with capabilities across consumer, merchant, courier, order and enterprise domains, payment processing, payouts, fraud and risk, regulatory compliance, accounting, financial data and platform infrastructure. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious.</li> <li>Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking - You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, integrations, data flows, and operational systems behind Money Domain (Financial Systems). You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect end-to-end consumer, rider/ courier, and merchant experiences, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs.</li> <li>Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action - Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind.</li> <li>Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes - You will understand the merchant, partner, customer, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution.&nbsp;</li> </ul&gt

Purpose of the role As Head of Pricing - Insurance at Zego, you will lead the insurer’s technical view of the models that drive our pricing. That covers the actuarial risk models behind our net rates, the demand and market models, and any other predictive model used for pricing and underwriting decisions. The models are built by the MGA pricing teams using a mix of traditional techniques (GLM, GAM, GBM) as well as new AI driven approaches. Your role is to make sure that we, as the insurer, can form an actuarial view on all of them, validate what sits underneath, and stand behind the rates it carries. On the actuarial risk models you will go further still, joining those projects from the start and owning the independent validation end to end. You will do this as the senior technical voice in a small actuarial team, which brings real breadth alongside the depth. Alongside the models you will review pricing and underwriting proposals across both personal and commercial motor in close collaboration with our underwriting team, and you will bring the modelling view into portfolio management. You will work directly with the MGA pricing teams, with underwriting and with our co-insurance partners, with access to senior leadership and to decision making from the first week. What you will be working on Lead the insurer’s technical view across the full model landscape: the actuarial risk models, the demand models, the market and optimisation models. For each one the questions are the same: is the approach sound, can the output be trusted, and are we using it the way we intend to. jobs.title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
jobs.description: The Opportunity Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin. The Role You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails. What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules. By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release. What You'll Do Run pre-layout channel studies to set routing topologies, stackups, materials and design constraints for high-speed interfaces. Carry out post-layout SI analysis of critical channels: insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis using IBIS-AMI models. Design and optimise vias, breakouts, connector launches, and the transitions into optical engines and co-packaged components. Set PDN impedance targets, design decoupling strategies, and run DC drop and AC PDN analysis for high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Support package, interposer and board co-simulation with the ASIC team to keep channel and power integrity sound end to end. Correlate simulation with lab measurements using TDRs, VNAs and oscilloscopes, and feed the results back into models and design rules. Evaluate and characterise PCB materials, connectors and cable assemblies with suppliers and fabricators. Build up our SI/PI methodology, model libraries and design guidelines so they can be reused across projects. What We're Looking For Must-have A degree in electronic engineering, physics or a related discipline, plus proven SI/PI experience on high-speed PCB and/or package designs. Proficiency with at least one major EM and circuit simulation suite, such as Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Keysight ADS or Cadence Sigrity/Clarity. Strong understanding of transmission line theory, S-parameters, crosstalk, loss mechanisms and channel compliance metrics such as eye diagrams and COM. Experience with IBIS and IBIS-AMI models for SerDes and memory interface simulation. Solid knowledge of PDN design, including impedance targeting, decoupling optimisation and DC IR drop analysis. Strong preference for Hands-on measurement with VNAs, TDRs and high-speed oscilloscopes, and the ability to correlate measurements with simulation. 56G/112G PAM4 channels, or PCIe Gen5/6 compliance. Package and interposer co-simulation, including chip-package-board analysis. Low-loss PCB materials and fabrication tolerances and their effect on high-speed performance. Scripting (Python, MATLAB) to automate simulation and post-processing. About Lumai Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics

jobs.title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Analog Design
jobs.description: The Opportunity At the centre of an optical computer sits a set of circuits that have to read, drive and hold steady some very small, very fast signals: photodetector front ends, laser and modulator drives, precision converter interfaces, and the quiet power and references underneath them. This role owns them, at board level, from the optical requirement through to the production build. The Role You will design the board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits that connect our electronics to light, and take them the whole way: specification, simulation, layout guidance, lab bring-up, characterisation and production. You will agree the optical requirements - optical power budgets, bandwidth, noise, linearity - with the photonics and system teams, and turn them into analog architectures and circuit specifications. What is genuinely hard about it is working at the boundary between optics, mixed-signal and high-speed digital, where noise budgets are tight and the measurement is as demanding as the design. A microvolt-level front end does not care that the same board carries high-current switching rails; getting both right on one stackup is the job. By month six, you will have characterised at least one full analog subsystem on the bench, correlated it with simulation across corners, and put the layout constraints and test procedures in place that other engineers can follow. What You'll Do Design board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits: photodiode front ends, TIAs, ADC/DAC driver and reconstruction stages, laser drivers, modulator drivers and bias networks. Translate photonic system requirements into analog specifications and architectures with the photonics and system teams. Design low-noise power delivery for sensitive circuits: LDO post-regulation, filtering, precision voltage and current references, grounding and partitioning schemes. Design control loops and precision circuits for photonic components: TEC and temperature control, laser current control, monitor photodiode readout and heater drivers. Run circuit simulation and analysis (SPICE, noise, stability, worst-case, Monte Carlo) and confirm designs meet performance across corners. Give placement, routing and grounding guidance to the layout engineer, review layouts for analog integrity, and select and qualify analog components through to production. Lead lab bring-up and characterisation of analog circuits - noise, bandwidth, linearity, stability, crosstalk - and correlate the results with simulation. Work with the ASIC team on chip-to-board analog interfaces, including on-chip versus off-chip analog partitioning. What We're Looking For Must-have A degree in electronic engineering or a related discipline, plus extensive experience designing analog and mixed-signal circuits at board level for products that reached production. Strong analog fundamentals covering op-amp and amplifier design, feedback and stability, noise analysis, filtering and precision circuit design. Hands-on experience designing TIAs or other low-noise, high-bandwidth amplifier front ends. Experience interfacing high-performance ADCs and DACs, including driver design, anti-aliasing and reconstruction filtering, clocking sensitivity and reference design. Solid knowledge of low-noise power supply design, grounding, shielding and mixed-signal partitioning. Strong preference for SPICE-based simulation (LTspice, Cadence PSpice/Spectre, TINA or equivalent) and schematic capture in Cadence OrCAD/Allegro or Altium. Bench characterisation with oscilloscopes, spectrum and network analysers and precision source-measure equipment, and low-noise measurement technique. Writing layout constraints for sensitive analog circuits and reviewing layouts critically. Photonic or optoelectronic systems: photodetector receivers, laser diode drivers, optical modulator drivers or optical transceivers. Mentoring other engineers in analog design practice. jobs.description: <p class="Lexical__paragraph"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default</strong></strong></p> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: <strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">privacy is a fundamental human right</strong></strong>. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!</p> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it.&nbsp;Join us and do work you can truly be proud of.&nbsp;Check our&nbsp;open-source&nbsp;projects&nbsp;<a class="Lexical__link" href="https://proton.me/community/open-source">here</a>!</p> <p class="Lexical__paragraph"><strong>The Proton Drive Desktop Team</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Proton Drive is our secure, private cloud storage and collaborative editing suite, with clients on Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, and Web. One platform is missing: Linux. You will build it from scratch. This is a greenfield project with high visibility inside Proton and across the open-source community — our entire client codebase is published under an open-source license, and this will be the first public example of how to build a native application on top of the Proton Drive SDK. You will work closely with our Windows and Mac engineers to ensure feature parity, and you will contribute to our platform-agnostic SDK and CLI tooling as the Linux surface area demands it. If building something that the Linux community has been waiting for, and doing it in the open, is the kind of work that gets you out of bed — this role is for you.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]"><strong>Tech Stack and Tools</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3"> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Linux desktop application development (GTK+ or Qt)</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Rust (nice to have)</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Git, CI/CD pipelines</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Linux packaging and distribution (Debian, Fedora-based)</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3"> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Own the design and implementation of the Proton Drive Linux desktop client, built greenfield from the ground up.</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Ensure the codebase meets the standard expected of product

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Inference
jobs.description: You'll own how Luma's models get served — integrating new architectures into the inference engine, scaling deployments across thousands of machines, and keeping expensive GPU fleets busy while meeting internal SLOs. This is large-scale inference systems work: scheduling, fleet management, deployment pipelines, and reliability across clusters and hardware providers. It fits a strong systems engineer comfortable with model serving and Kubernetes at scale. If you want pure modeling rather than the systems that run models, this is firmly the systems side. What You'll Own Ship new model architectures by integrating them into the inference engine. Collaborate across research, engineering, and infrastructure to optimize model efficiency and deployments. Build internal tooling to measure, profile, and track the lifetime of inference jobs and workflows. Automate, test, and maintain inference services for maximum uptime and reliability. Manage and optimize inference workloads across clusters and hardware providers, and scale deployments across thousands of machines. Build scheduling systems that use expensive GPU resources optimally while meeting SLOs, and maintain CI/CD for model checkpoints and SDKs. First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold. Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the inference stack, the fleets, and where reliability or utilization break. Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Integrate a model or ship tooling/scheduling that improves uptime or GPU utilization. Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Harden deployment pipelines and scheduling across clusters and providers. What You Bring Strong Python and system-architecture skills. jobs.description: You'll build the systems that make reinforcement learning work at frontier scale — coupling policy optimization with large fleets of inference workers, agentic environments, and the reward and verification systems that turn model behavior into learning signal. RL is how Luma's models go from capable to useful. RL at scale is a full-loop systems problem: training, rollout generation, environment execution, and reward computation running concurrently across thousands of GPUs, all needing to stay fast, stable, and correct together. It fits someone who has lived this — post-trained LLMs with RL, built environments and verifiers, and debugged asynchronous rollout pipelines at scale. If you haven't operated RL at real scale, this will be deep water. What You'll Own Design, build, and scale distributed RL post-training systems, orchestrating trainer, rollout, environment, and reward workloads across thousands of GPUs. Build high-throughput rollout generation, integrating inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), weight synchronization, and asynchronous/off-policy schemes. Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks — sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction — reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes. Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking. Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable. Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers. First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold. Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the current RL stack and where throughput, stability, or correctness break. Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Improve a piece of the loop (rollout throughput, reward infra, or an environment) and prove it on a real run. What You Bring Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with RL (PPO/GRPO-family, RLHF, RLVR) at meaningful scale. Extensive distributed PyTorch training and parallelism (FSDP, Tensor/Pipeline/Expert Parallel) for foundation models. Experience building RL environments, reward functions, verifiers, or evaluation harnesses for LLM agents, including sandboxed execution and multi-turn tool use. Deep familiarity with RL post-training frameworks (veRL, OpenRLHF, TRL, Ray orchestration) and rollout inference engines (vLLM, SGLang). Containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, Ray) for large environment fleets and sandboxed workloads. Research contributions in RL for LLMs, or open-source contributions to RL training frameworks. jobs.title: Founding Sales @Hodor (backed by Hexa)
jobs.description: Hodor is the security gateway for AI agent governance — between your harnesses and your applications, making sure each agent has the right tools for the right job. Nothing more. https://www.hodor.ai/ Create your territory. Cold call. Own your pipe end to end. This is the first sales hire at Hodor — no inbound, no SDR feeding you, no playbook to inherit. You decide who to attack, you pick up the phone, you close, and you write the motion the rest of the sales team will run on. Build like a founder. Create your own territory — choose the segments, accounts and personas worth attacking, and defend the thesis. Cold call, every day. Phone, email, LinkedIn, events — whatever gets the first real conversation. Own your pipeline end to end: discovery, technical evaluation, security review, pricing, negotiation, close. Run POCs with security and platform teams, and turn pilots into signed contracts. Write the playbook as you go — ICP, qualification, objection handling, pricing, and the collateral behind it. Bring the market back to the product: what enterprises ask for, what blocks a deal, what wins one. Stand up the GTM stack — CRM discipline, sequences, forecasting — so the next hires inherit a system, not a mess. Represent Hodor in the field: meetups, conferences, CISO and platform-leader circles. Hire and ramp the first AEs and SDRs once the motion is repeatable. What you bring Real closing experience in B2B SaaS — you've carried a quota and beaten it, and you can walk through the deals. You cold call without flinching. Prospection is the job, not a chore you delegate. Comfort selling a technical product to technical buyers — CISOs, CTOs, platform and security teams. Founder mentality: no inbound, no playbook, no safety net — you'd rather build the machine than operate someone else's. Enterprise deal instincts: multiple stakeholders, procurement, security questionnaires, legal. Fluent in French and English — we sell in France first, Europe next. Nice to have You've sold cybersecurity, developer tools, or data infrastructure. You were among the first ten at a startup and watched a GTM motion go from zero to repeatable. Familiarity with AI agents, MCP, or how large enterprises are actually deploying LLMs internally. You build your own GTM tooling and automations (Clay, HubSpot, Apollo) rather than just using them. Not for you if… You need inbound leads or an SDR to fill your calendar. You want a defined territory, a mature playbook, and a comp plan that never moves. You think cold calling is beneath you. You'd rather manage a team than close deals yourself for the first year. You prefer fully-remote work (we work 3+ days a week from the office). You don't thrive at the fast pace of early-stage startups. Why join us A real problem to solve: AI agent security is the strategic question of the moment. It isn't one more feature — it's a defence against an existential risk for large enterprises. You're not joining a sales org, you're founding one — and the playbook has your name on it. Momentum: pre-seed already raised (Hexa and others), seed planned within 6–12 months. You join a team that's accelerating. Winners of the VivaTech Innovation of the Year award, and part of a top Station F programme. Work shoulder to shoulder with the founders, with a direct line to the roadmap you're selling. French and sovereign by design — based in Paris, French infrastructure, European values. Interested ? jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer
jobs.description: At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail. We are looking for a  Platform Security Engineer  to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity. This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound. About Scality Scality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox. Industry recognition: Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years  — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception #1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage  (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors Gold Stevie Award 2025  — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category Net Promoter Score of 85  across RING and ARTESCA About the team You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining  ADI  (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform:  RING  (object storage),  S3C  (S3-compatible layer), and  SCOS  (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution). The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers. How We Build We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day. We are also designing something larger: an  AI code and delivery factory  — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build. If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it. One principle is not negotiable:  a human owns the outcome.  AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all. How This Role Works Scality is building a  network of security engineers across the engineering department  — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering.  The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is ho

jobs.title: Account Manager Lille
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Pourquoi Deliveroo ? Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent. Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre! Tes principales missions :   Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l'expertise et l'attention au détail font toute la différence. Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech. Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data. Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d'amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté. Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l'attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires. Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible. Ton expérience et tes qualités : Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d'un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission. Tu sais négocier et anticiper les discussions commerciales tout en gardant à l'esprit les valeurs de Deliveroo. Tu sais garder le contrôle de ton portefeuille , identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et partager du feedback utile à tes partenaires ainsi qu'à ton manager. Le terrain est un lieu où tu te sens à ta place : tu sais construire des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires tout en gardant un œil attentif sur la concurrence. Tu sais te montrer proactif , analyser les résultats de tes actions et proposer des recommandations concrètes à ton manager. Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en gardant le cap fixé, sais t'approprier des objectifs précis et mets tout en œuvre pour les atteindre. Tu sais concevoir des actions spécifiques , adaptées à la fois aux besoins de tes partenaires et à la stratégie définie par ton manager. Tu sais identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance (commerciales et opérationnelles) pour garantir un niveau de service irréprochable. Tu sais t'exprimer en anglais (à l'oral comme à l'écrit) Tu arrives à convaincre tout en construisant des relations commerciales solides, durables, où Deliveroo devient le partenaire de choix Et si tu cherches un poste où tu travailles en full remote depuis Lille , tout en gardant un lien fort avec le terrain et les équipes, alors c'est peut‑être le rôle qu'il te faut ! La vie chez Deliveroo Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix. Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ?

Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. In this role, you will focus heavily on Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Advanced Deep Learning architectures. You will bridge the gap between experimental data science and production-ready ML systems. Working closely with our Data Science and Engineering teams, you will scale complex models, optimize training and inference pipelines, and leverage cloud ecosystems to deliver robust biomedical solutions. Experience handling health, clinical, or omics data (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, etc.) is a major plus. In particular, you will: Develop scalable machine learning libraries, tooling, and research workflows in close partnership with research and data scientists. Shape research infrastructure requirements and drive tool and software choices in collaboration with the platform team. Champion software engineering best practices across the team, enabling researchers and scientists to write maintainable, testable, efficient, and scalable code. Design and enhance systems for experiment tracking, reproducibility, and end-to-end model lifecycle management. Contribute to and accelerate the rapid prototyping of novel models, helping bridge early research and robust implementation. ML/DL Frameworks & Ecosystems: Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistical methods, and deep learning frameworks. Mastery of PyTorch or TensorFlow. LLM Specialization: Deep understanding of Transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, and the latest breakthroughs in Generative AI. Extensive experience with Hugging Face, with knowledge in agentic workflows and RAG. Cloud & MLOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and SageMaker Software Engineering Culture: Strong engineering practices including version control, comprehensive testing, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker). Contributions to open-source ML projects or research publications. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran. We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey. You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead. 💼 Your Responsibilities Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast. Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce. Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond. Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures. Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours. Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone. Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises. 🤝 Who You'll Work With Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team. Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO. Working model: You

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
jobs.description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does. Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. jobs.title: Associate Director/ Director FP&A EMEA

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.   Summary of Position: Reporting to the VP, Finance EMEA, the Associate Director/ Director, FP&A will support Scholar Rock’s EMEA organization. The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of planning and delivering against financial objectives in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. In this role, they will serve as a strategic partner in framing, evaluating, and driving decisions to maximize value creation. Success will require clear communication, strong organization, and a collaborative mindset. Support FP&A activities including budgeting and forecasting, long-range planning, scenario modeling, and financial analysis for strategic initiatives. Build and maintain patient and revenue models, ensuring appropriate underlying assumptions for direct and partner markets. Partner with EMEA Accounting on month-end and quarter-end close activities, quarterly schedules, procure-to-pay processes, and support for external reporting and audit inquiries. Deliver timely monthly budget-to-actual analyses, including variance analysis and management reporting. Drive continuous improvement of FP&A processes to increase efficiency while maintaining flexibility to meet evolving business needs. Develop and deliver training and change-management support to drive adoption of new FP&A tools, systems, and ways of working across the organization. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Meta (all genders)
jobs.description: JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Meta product domain and help shape the experience that connects our games with the broader JustPlay platform. At JustPlay, Meta is the layer between core gameplay and our rewards platform - including progress, rewards, boosters, LiveOps, and the experiences that connect each game to the wider JustPlay ecosystem. The Meta team owns this layer across our full game portfolio, extending platform features into games and building shared, reusable components that can be adopted across multiple titles. This helps us create a consistent player experience and scale new features across the portfolio without rebuilding them game by game. In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem. What sets this role apart? You'll be building for an entire portfolio of 50+ games, not just a single title. That means thinking in systems, balancing the needs of different games and player journeys, and shaping solutions that can scale across the JustPlay ecosystem. Job Responsibilities Own the product strategy, priorities, and key results for your area within the Meta domain Identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities across the JustPlay ecosystem, balancing player needs, business goals, and technical constraints. Drive complex product problems with a high degree of autonomy, from identifying the opportunity through launch, measurement, and iteration Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Data game teams, and other Product team members to shape solutions, align on priorities, and bring impactful features to life. Translate player needs, business goals, and product insights into clear product priorities and solutions Manage priorities and trade-offs across multiple initiatives while keeping teams aligned on goals and outcomes Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and continuously improve the product Contribute to a strong feedback culture by sharing perspectives openly, challenging ideas constructively, and actively giving and receiving feedback across the Product team Job Requirements 5+ years of Product Management experience within mobile or another B2C digital product, ideally with exposure to mobile games, gamification, loyalty, or rewards products. Proven experience owning a product area or domain, including strategy, prioritization, key results, and measurable outcomes Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using data to make product decisions and evaluate impact Experience working with cross-functional teams, particularly Engineering, Design, and Data Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn complex challenges into clear product solutions Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing priorities and adapting as new information emerges Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback and contributing openly within the Product team Excellent English communication skills Job Benefits Work-Life Balance and Flexibility : Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers Mental Health Support : Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work Training & Development : A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply Germany-Based Benefits : 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
jobs.description: Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm. Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden. Dein Aufgabenbereich Startphase (erste Wochen): Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf. Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards. Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse. Im weiteren Verlauf: Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte. Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher. Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete. Das bieten wir dir Strukturierter Einstieg : Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards Mentoring & Coaching : regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt) Skalierbare Perspektive : Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr” Team mit Performance-Kultur : klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse Nichts für dich, wenn… du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst Muss Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH) Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich) Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse Wunsch Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer (German-speaking) — Core Experience (Remote in Europe)
jobs.description: About Finom   Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. jobs.description: Your mission This is not a normal job. Please read this part before you read anything else. If you are highly driven, extremely ambitious, and you want to do the work of your life at a company that will change how people get access to new therapies and shared medical knowledge, mama health is the place for you. In return, you get ownership, speed, and a problem worth your time. You will get obsessed with metrics. Not dashboards for a weekly meeting. How fast depends on you. - - - - - As a Product Manager at mama health, you will shape and execute product of one of the most exciting AI companies in healthcare. You will work closely with the founders, engineers, designers, and medical experts to build products that help patients understand their diseases, and that help healthcare organizations learn directly from patient experiences at scale. You do more than people ask. Strong analytical thinking and problem solving You learn fast and you like to be out of your comfort zone Clear communication with engineers, designers, and business people Fluent English is required. jobs.description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team Our Defence team is focused on building and embedding human-centered AI solutions which give our nation a competitive edge in the defence sector. We collaborate with our clients to bring ethical, reliable and cutting-edge AI to high-stakes situations and maintain the balance of global powers essential to our liberty. Because of the nature of the work we do with our Defence clients, you will need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work between 2 to 4 days per week on-site with these customers which may require travel to locations throughout the UK. When not required on client sites, you’ll have the flexibility to work from our London office or remotely from elsewhere within the UK. About the role As a Customer Director for Aerospace in Defence, you will be a trusted partner and strategic lead for our Aerospace work with the MOD, RAF and Industry clients. This will include driving real world AI applications in both Civil and Military sectors in addition to the Space domain. You will own key client relationships, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact. You will also act as a strategic entrepreneur, building our market presence and bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI and mission-critical needs. By blending deep domain expertise with delivery leadership, you will secure high-stakes partnerships and oversee multidisciplinary teams to ensure our technology delivers transformational capability for UK and Allied Defence. What you'll be doing: Leading strategic accounts across UK MOD and Industry to build long-term partnerships focused on strategic advantage through cutting edge AI. Cultivating deep, strategic relationships with senior stakeholders to unlock long-term partnership opportunities. Designing transformation programmes in collaboration with technical experts that integrate advanced AI into mission-critical capabilities. Overseeing delivery excellence across cross-functional teams of engineers, researchers, and delivery leads to ensure high-stakes projects succeed. Developing commercial strategies and proposals that expand our work across Aerospace and Space both in the UK and internationally to meet ambitious growth goals. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. jobs.description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. About the role: We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to strengthen the systems that power our go-to-market teams. This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the processes, workflows, automations, and data architecture that accelerate how we find, engage, win, onboard, retain, and expand customers at scale. You will partner across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership to turn fragmented systems and manual work into a high-leverage GTM engine. If you naturally think: “This should be an automated system, not a spreadsheet.” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. We would love to connect with you about enabling our rapidly growing revenue team. You will play a key role in increasing internal efficiency and productivity to support the team in creating the best customer experience, and in driving commercial success. Your responsibilities will include: CRM and revenue tech stack architecture Own end-to-end CRM administration as the single source of truth for revenue activities Manage the design, configuration, and roadmap of a connected revenue tech stack Set and enforce data governance standards: field hygiene, deduplication, permissions, and ongoing data-quality monitoring Automation and data foundation Automate and enrich the manual layer with workflows and LLMs Build and maintain operational dashboards (recurring KPIs, data hygiene, system adoption) Advise with thought leadership on which tooling we procure next as we scale Cross-functional partnership and enablement Operational business partner to GTM leadership Drive systems and process adoption across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership teams through training and enablement Act as first point of contact for revenue system support tickets What success looks like in 12 months: GTM signals are consistently translated into actionable workflows Sellers and customer-facing teams spend materially less time on manual admin and prep Critical revenue systems are connected, key workflows are AI-assisted or fully automated Leadership has a real-time view into pipeline, conversion, execution, and customer health You're a great fit if you: 5+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations in a B2B SaaS hypergrowth environment Deep hands-on expertise in CRM administration (HubSpot/Salesforce) Proven track record building revenue systems, processes, and data flows from scratch Persistent problem-solver at your core Sharp entrepreneurial instincts and analytical mindset Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management What you can look forward to: Taking full ownership

C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir. Ce que tu vas faire 🖇 1. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires. Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions 3. Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous , c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel

jobs.title: Senior Key Account Executive
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec le manager. Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. Entretien final avec la Direction. Localisation : Montagnat (01) et Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour par semaine sur chaque site et 3 jours de télétravail. Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS   Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.   Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).     VOTRE RÔLE Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image. Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison. Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…). Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations. Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants. Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports. Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication. VOTRE PROFIL  Excellente culture graphique et artistique. Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création. Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes.
