jobs.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the latest — Privacy Pro . Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include: Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer , you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo. About You 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript. Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python. Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases. Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause. Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact. Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients. Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight. Compensation $178,500 USD annually and stock options. jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager - Dissemination & Distribution
jobs.description: If you're a driven sales professional with deep roots in the asset management sector and a passion for connecting clients to the data solutions they depend on, this is a rare opportunity to own and shape a high-growth territory across DACH and Central Europe. As Senior Business Development Manager, you'll take the lead on one of FE fundinfo's most strategically important regions, bringing our Dissemination & Distribution solutions to asset managers, fund promoters, platforms and data vendors across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. This is a role where your market knowledge, client relationships and commercial instincts will directly influence product direction, go-to-market strategy, and the growth of a business that sits at the heart of the fund distribution ecosystem. You'll work alongside talented colleagues across sales, product and client success, with the backing of a dedicated BDR team and marketing function. Your key responsibilities as a Senior Business Development Manager will include: Owning and executing the sales strategy for our Dissemination and Distribution solutions across asset managers and fund promoters in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. Driving pipeline growth and bookings through programmatic execution of the DACH and Central Europe go-to-market plan, including cross-sell and new name sales plays. Positioning FE fundinfo's Dissemination solutions to help clients distribute fund data, factsheets and regulatory documents to platforms, distributors and data vendors. Partnering with marketing and a dedicated BDR team to drive demand, and representing FE fundinfo at industry events across the DACH and Central European markets. Collaborating with Client Success Managers to deliver a seamless post-sales experience and with product teams to bring client insight into the roadmap. Supporting the development of junior sales team members by sharing best practices and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement. You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Senior Business Development Manager: You have a proven track record in SaaS technology or data sales, with direct experience selling into the asset management sector. You have consistently performed in a quota-bearing sales environment, managing pipelines and delivering against revenue targets. You are fluent in English to at least C1 level, with strong written and verbal communication and executive presence. You are proficient in applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to qualify and close complex, high-value opportunities. You are willing to travel regularly across the DACH and Central European territory to build and maintain senior client relationships. FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence! At FE fundinfo, we believe that great work happens when people are trusted, supported and given the space to grow. You'll join a team of commercially minded, intellectually curious professionals who collaborate across borders and disciplines. We offer flexible and hybrid working arrangements, a strong culture of learning and development, and regular team events that bring people together — whether you're based in Frankfurt or Zurich. Apply now and we'll aim to get back to you with feedback within 5 working days. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Lead Generation
jobs.description: Das sind wir Seit 2000 macht die ITA Logistics Group den Versand für Unternehmen einfacher, transparenter und effizienter. Mit unseren Plattformen LetMeShip und ParcelParcel können Unternehmen ihren täglichen Versand schnell vergleichen und direkt buchen. Dabei bündeln wir zahlreiche Versanddienstleister auf unseren Plattformen und kombinieren moderne Technologie mit persönlichem Service. An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten. Deine Rolle Deine 20 Stunden bei uns verbringst du vor allem damit, neue Unternehmen anzusprechen und erste Kontakte zu potenziellen Kunden aufzubauen. Dafür stellen wir dir bereits Leadlisten mit interessanten Unternehmen zur Verfügung. Gleichzeitig recherchierst du auch selbst, welche weiteren Unternehmen gut zu LetMeShip passen könnten, ermittelst die richtigen Ansprechpartner und greifst zum Hörer. Mal erreichst du sofort die passende Person, mal brauchst du mehrere Anläufe. Du lernst, Gespräche zu eröffnen, zuzuhören und echtes Interesse zu erkennen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen gut vorbereiteten Präsentationstermin für unsere Sales Manager zu vereinbaren. Dafür hältst du fest, was das Unternehmen versendet, welche Anforderungen bestehen und welche Fragen im ersten Gespräch aufgekommen sind. Im anschließenden Präsentationstermin übernimmt unser Sales Manager, stellt LetMeShip ausführlich vor, zeigt die Vorteile und Funktionen unserer Plattform und geht konkret auf den individuellen Versandbedarf des Unternehmens ein. jobs.title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
jobs.description: Your tasks Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship. Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved. Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended. Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next. Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging. From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly. Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs. Your profile Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half. Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people. Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be. Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic. Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models. Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters. Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement. Why us? Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers. Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket. Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known. Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about. How to Apply Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production : what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed. Process : Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer. We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway. jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager UK
jobs.description: Our project for you: moebel.de is Europe's leading price comparison site for furniture and home furnishings. Our family of portals operates in nine European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Italy and Poland. Now we are getting started in earnest in the UK: living24.uk is live – our price comparison site for furniture, home furnishings, garden and décor, as well as white goods and home electronics. The launch is done, the technology works. What decides the pace now are the retailers: the more relevant shops list their ranges on living24.uk, the stronger the comparison for users – and the faster the portal grows. This is not selling from a tidy list of existing accounts. You take on a freshly launched market and build the partner portfolio that living24.uk runs on. Whoever delivers over the next few months will shape what moebel.de looks like in the UK. That is why we are looking for you as Senior Sales Manager UK. Your future Tasks Building the market: you build living24.uk's partner portfolio – from first contact through pitch and negotiation to the signed contract. Your targets are UK online retailers in furniture, home furnishings, garden, décor, white goods, home electronics and small appliances. Selling a performance model: you show retailers how living24.uk pays off as an additional channel – through cost per click, visibility, feed quality and cost-of-sale. Seeing partners through to go-live: product feed, tracking, range checks – together with the team in Hamburg. After go-live our Relationship Management team takes over day-to-day care, so you can focus on winning new partners. Presence in the market: retailer visits, trade fairs and industry events across the UK. In a young market, trust is built face to face. Ear to the ground: competition, price levels, what UK retailers expect, seasonality – what you learn in the field feeds into product, pricing and priorities. Your Strenghts Several years of sales experience in UK e-commerce, ideally with a price comparison site, marketplace, affiliate network or performance marketing provider A solid network of UK retailers in our categories that you can put to work from day one Command of the performance model: CPC, CPO, affiliate, product feeds, ROAS and cost-of-sale are selling points for you, not buzzwords A hunter's mindset: you keep your own pipeline full, cold outreach included, and get deals over the line An appetite for building: pace and open questions appeal to you more than a field that has already been ploughed Working from the numbers, with clean CRM records as the basis for how you steer Willingness to travel across the UK and to regular meetings in Hamburg Fluent English at negotiation level – German is a plus, not a requirement Our Benefits Your day is yours to shape Work when you are most productive. Early bird or night owl: you set your hours flexibly, in agreement with your team. Working from another European country for a while? No problem. Your laptop is your workplace. Our culture is one of a kind Here everyone sits on the same couch, regardless of title or role. We live team spirit online and in person – gaming nights, workouts, film evenings and team events. Four times a year we meet for Company Week Working together in the office, pushing projects forward, pizza evenings and a party to finish. In the heart of Hamburg When you are in Hamburg, our office is waiting for you – centrally located between the main station, Mönckebergstraße and the Binnenalster lake. Perfect for lunch dates, a break by the Alster or a stroll after work. We are looking forward to receiving your application! jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Staff Machine Learning Engineer In Brief We’re an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. Part Data Scientist (building models), part Applied Scientist (productionizing models), and part MLE (deploying, maintaining), also known as “Full Stack Data Scientist” – someone who wants to own the end-to-end effectiveness of their real-time models in a live, clinical AI product. Who We Are Bayesian Health ’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. In practice, that means you aren’t afraid to get your hands dirty by writing data mapping code, debugging a specific patient case by following patient data as it moves through our AWS services, or improving the timeliness of your model’s predictions by reading and writing production-grade Python and SQL code. Responsibilities Model Prototyping: Develop and tune innovative, new ML models and labeler systems based on deep understanding of clinical use cases and state-of-the-art ML methods. Productionizing: The same models that you develop with production-grade python. Deploying: Identify strategies for improving our production ML-based systems, and write, debug, and deploying production-grade Python code to implement those strategies. Minimum qualifications Ph.D. in a relevant field plus 3+ years relevant experience, or a relevant Master’s degree and 5+ years experience shipping ML based software products. jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones . Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative. Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals. Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance. Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation. Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights. Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience. Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls. Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions. Job Requirements Successful candidates must: Have substantial professional writing experience , with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content. Support patient self-management of disease. Coordinate continuity of patient care with patients and families following hospital admission, discharge, and ER visits. jobs.description: About Delos Insurance Solutions Delos is a technology-forward insurance company focused on the Excess & Surplus (E&S) market. We’re reimagining specialty insurance by leveraging automation and data to underwrite complex risks efficiently. As we scale into additional states, we are strengthening our compliance infrastructure to ensure operational excellence and continuous regulatory alignment. Position Overview Delos Insurance Solutions is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Personal Lines Property Underwriter to support our growing underwriting operations. This role is responsible for evaluating new business and renewal submissions, assessing property risks, managing ongoing underwriting activities, and maintaining strong relationships with appointed agents. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in personal lines property insurance, sound underwriting judgment, and the ability to balance profitable risk selection with business growth. This individual will also contribute to underwriting process improvements, guideline development, and operational efficiency in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. Key Responsibilities Underwriting & Risk Assessment Review, evaluate, and underwrite new business and renewal submissions for homeowners and other residential property lines. Manage daily underwriting activities, including inspection reviews, endorsements, and system-generated tasks. Assess property risk characteristics in accordance with established underwriting guidelines and company risk appetite. Identify and select profitable risks while minimizing adverse selection. Meet or exceed established production and quality standards. Exercise assigned underwriting authority to approve minor exceptions, including one class deviation or one guideline exception, where permitted. Escalate exceptions outside assigned authority to a Senior Underwriter for approval. Agent Communication & Collaboration Serve as a primary underwriting resource for appointed agents, answering questions, clarifying guidelines, and supporting quality submissions. Provide timely, accurate, and professional communication to agents, distribution partners, and internal stakeholders. Partner with the Distribution team to support agent training and underwriting education as needed. Collaborate with internal teams to improve underwriting efficiency, processes, and overall service quality. Underwriting Guidelines & Process Improvement Provide feedback on underwriting guidelines based on market conditions, emerging risks, and competitive insights. Support the development and implementation of underwriting referral and authority protocols. Contribute to underwriting training materials, workflow enhancements, and process improvements. Complete underwriting projects of low to moderate complexity as assigned by the Head of Underwriting. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of property underwriting or related personal lines insurance experience, preferably involving homeowners, dwelling fire, or residential property. Strong understanding of underwriting principles, risk assessment, and risk selection, or relevant experience in claims, insurance customer service, or related functions. Demonstrated ability to evaluate risks, apply underwriting guidelines, and make sound decisions within assigned authority. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-service mindset. Experience using underwriting platforms, exposure assessment tools, or business intelligence dashboards. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and sound judgment in balancing risk and business objectives. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and Adobe. Preferred Qualifications Active Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance license in any state; California license strongly preferred. Professional insurance designation

jobs.title: Personal Lines Property Underwriter
jobs.description: About Delos Insurance Solutions Delos is a technology-forward insurance company focused on the Excess & Surplus (E&S) market. We’re reimagining specialty insurance by leveraging automation and data to underwrite complex risks efficiently. As we scale into additional states, we are strengthening our compliance infrastructure to ensure operational excellence and continuous regulatory alignment. Position Overview Delos Insurance Solutions is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Personal Lines Property Underwriter to support our growing underwriting operations. This role is responsible for evaluating new business and renewal submissions, assessing property risks, managing ongoing underwriting activities, and maintaining strong relationships with appointed agents. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in personal lines property insurance, sound underwriting judgment, and the ability to balance profitable risk selection with business growth. This individual will also contribute to underwriting process improvements, guideline development, and operational efficiency in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. Key Responsibilities Underwriting & Risk Assessment Review, evaluate, and underwrite new business and renewal submissions for homeowners and other residential property lines. Manage daily underwriting activities, including inspection reviews, endorsements, and system-generated tasks. Assess property risk characteristics in accordance with established underwriting guidelines and company risk appetite. Identify and select profitable risks while minimizing adverse selection. Meet or exceed established production and quality standards. Exercise assigned underwriting authority to approve minor exceptions, including one class deviation or one guideline exception, where permitted. Escalate exceptions outside assigned authority to a Senior Underwriter for approval. Agent Communication & Collaboration Serve as a primary underwriting resource for appointed agents, answering questions, clarifying guidelines, and supporting quality submissions. Provide timely, accurate, and professional communication to agents, distribution partners, and internal stakeholders. Partner with the Distribution team to support agent training and underwriting education as needed. Collaborate with internal teams to improve underwriting efficiency, processes, and overall service quality. Underwriting Guidelines & Process Improvement Provide feedback on underwriting guidelines based on market conditions, emerging risks, and competitive insights. Support the development and implementation of underwriting referral and authority protocols. Contribute to underwriting training materials, workflow enhancements, and process improvements. Complete underwriting projects of low to moderate complexity as assigned by the Head of Underwriting. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of property underwriting or related personal lines insurance experience, preferably involving homeowners, dwelling fire, or residential property. Strong understanding of underwriting principles, risk assessment, and risk selection, or relevant experience in claims, insurance customer service, or related functions. Demonstrated ability to evaluate risks, apply underwriting guidelines, and make sound decisions within assigned authority. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-service mindset. Experience using underwriting platforms, exposure assessment tools, or business intelligence dashboards. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and sound judgment in balancing risk and business objectives. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and Adobe. Preferred Qualifications Active Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance license in any state; California license strongly preferred. Professional insurance designation

jobs.title: Civil Associate - Surface Water
jobs.description: Job title: Civil Associate - Surface Water Job Location : Santa Ana, CA 92707. Employer allows remote work for this position. Salary: $105,476 – 121,458 Job duties: Under close supervision, assist Civil Engineers, Technical Managers, and Project Managers with data analysis, computations, design and plan production on water/wastewater civil engineering projects. Assist with design, construction documents, plan production, maps, basic reports and other supporting documentation for water and wastewater engineering projects. Gather background information related to a project site which includes reviewing as-built plans and mapping existing utility service. Produce high-quality 1D and 2D surface water hydraulic models for floodplain mapping of individual watershed domains within the project site. Conduct feasibility studies for the construction of facilities, such as water supply systems, runoff collection networks, water and wastewater treatment plants, or wastewater collection systems. Prepare environmental documentation for regulatory program compliance. Perform hydrological analyses, using three-dimensional simulation software to model the movement of water.
